push_id.description: Stable identifier for this push; used to correlate tasks to GitHub issues.

status.description: Current state of the push operation.

repo_full_name.description: GitHub owner/repo string, e.g. 'alice/my-project'. Null until the repo is created.

repo_url.description: HTTPS URL for the created GitHub repository. Null until the repo is created.

issue_count.description: Number of GitHub Issues created (one per T-NNN task).

pushed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the push completed. Null if still in progress.
